_readme: S359 SkyMoss, 2026-10-10, third emphasis read. With cq_subject_lists() (#1965), the re-captures gave Moreno Valley and Norco six of their seven emphasis degrees a page; Kinesiology, Health and Wellness still found none. Its Program Course File list is mostly courses numbered with a leading letter (KIN A03, KIN V01, KIN A31A), which CQ_NUM reads only after a C. This read loads Riverside City's Kinesiology, Health and Wellness entry (6289, "Kinesiology, Health and Wellness - Associate of Arts - AA498/AA498C") as _getPage JSON to see how its list is printed. One load, no model call.

questions.page_shape: How the emphasis prints its Kinesiology course numbers (A03, V01) after the subject's code.
